thread:
nina (product): Quick: need a crisp contract for when we serve "compat" variants so customers and alerts know it's intentional not an error.

sam (eng-platform): agreed. minimal: HTTP 200, small `route` metadata, and optional opt-in warning. no new status codes.

tess (eng-runtime): runtime can emit kind=compat and variant=compat-v2. We can map variant -> label for UI. Propose metadata.route.kind = "compat" and metadata.route.label = "compat".

mei (devex): don't expose model ids. UI should show friendly labels like "compat", "cached". Tooltip: "served by compatibility variant to maintain latency".

ryan (eng-sre): telemetry: add tags rw.route_kind and rw.variant_label. metrics: rw.compat.count, rw.compat.rate_pct, rw.compat.latency_p95. Alerts: warn >5% 6h, crit >20% 24h.

sam (eng-platform): API snippet: `X-RW-Route: compat|primary|cached` and body "route":{"kind":"compat","label":"compat"}; verbose param `?route_verbose=1` returns `warning`.

tess (eng-runtime): implementation: flag `expose_route_labels: none|labels|full`. hosted default labels. Dedicated can enable full (hashed ids).

mei (devex): console: per-route pill "compat (2.3%)" with hover details + link to runbook. no global banner unless >10%.

nina (product): OK. I'll draft docs and runbook. Owners: sam RFC, mei console, ryan alerts, tess runtime. Back in 48h for sign-off.
